title: @topo/cli: public surface
summary: The command interface and five modules re-exported by @topo/cli's package root. Arrows mean bin/export/type/dependency references, not a call sequence. This is a private workspace boundary bundled into @jdylanmc/topo-code, not a separately published or stable public SDK. Implementation helpers are deliberately omitted.

anchors.pattern:
HELP = `Topocode: local, deterministic repository maps

  topo init [repository] [--skills]
  topo scan [repository] [--allow-partial] [--responsibilities path]
  topo ingest <repository> <report.json> [more.json ...]
  topo enrich [repository]
  topo preview <repository> <story>
  topo story validate <repository> <story>
  topo story preview <repository> <story>
  topo serve [repository] [--port 4173]
  topo bundle [repository] [--output directory] [--base-path /path/]

Requires a Git repository and Node.js 22 or newer.
Scan is strict by default. --allow-partial publishes a visibly incomplete
preview and exits 2; it never turns partial evidence into success.
Serve binds only to 127.0.0.1. Config and authored metadata are never overwritten.
Init creates a ready-to-serve diagram home without scanning or opening a browser.
Scan adds repository exploration; story preview refreshes all committed stories.
`

sections.title: topo commands
sections.body:
The manifest exposes topo -> dist/main.js.

Commands: init, scan, story validate, story preview (and preview), serve, bundle, ingest, enrich.

Inputs: repository paths, authored stories, report files, and documented options. Outputs: diagnostics, generated storybook files, local URLs, and static bundles. scan supplies deterministic evidence; it does not invoke a model. runCli is exported by main.ts but is NOT re-exported from the package root.

sections.title: Generation API
sections.body:
Root exports from pipeline.ts:

generateArtifacts(root, graph, siteAssets, logicalArchitecture?, catalogue?) -> Promise<ArtifactGenerationResult>
ingestReports(root, inputPaths, siteAssets, expectedRevision?, catalogue?) -> Promise<ReportIngestionResult>

ArtifactGenerationResult: layout, optional dashboard, warnings.
ReportIngestionResult: dashboard, warnings.

Generation takes an already-supplied GraphDocument; do not confuse this API with the topo scan command. Referenced contracts include @topo/schema, @topo/graph and @topo/reports. BuiltCatalogue appears in signatures but is not itself a root re-export.

sections.title: Referenced contracts
sections.body:
The exposed functions reference GraphDocument and LogicalArchitectureDocument (@topo/schema), LayoutResult (@topo/graph), DashboardDocument (@topo/reports), CuratedViewsSnapshot / SaveCuratedViewRequest (@topo/views), Node's Server, and AbortSignal.

These are signature dependencies, not claims that @topo/cli re-exports all those types. Named result/option interfaces defined in the five exported modules are root exports.

sections.title: Serving API
sections.body:
Root exports from server.ts:

serveSite(root, port?) -> Promise<{ server: Server; url: string }>
composeSiteData(root, input) -> Promise<string | undefined>

serveSite exposes a loopback HTTP server over the generated site; it does not author architecture. composeSiteData composes site data for consumers. Source-backed diagrams and website assets remain separate from these function signatures.

sections.title: @topo/cli
Bundling API
sections.body:
Root exports from bundle.ts:

bundleSite(rootInput, outputInput, options?) -> Promise<BundleSiteResult>
BundleSiteOptions: optional basePath.
BundleSiteResult: basePath, outputDirectory, siteDirectory.

Produces a static site directory. Deployment, a domain, and publication approval are not implied by this API.

sections.title: Enrichment API
sections.body:
Root exports from enrichment.ts:

runEnrichment(root, options?) -> Promise<EnrichmentRunResult>
buildEnrichmentPrompt(inputPath, outputPath, analysisHash, customPrompt?) -> string
EnrichmentRunOptions: optional AbortSignal.
EnrichmentRunResult: analysisHash and comments count.

This is the explicit configured provider-command workflow. It is not automatically called by scan, and it is not the same thing as an agent independently interpreting evidence while authoring a story.

sections.title: Curated-view API
@topo/diagram-core
sections.body:
A declared workspace dependency of @topo/cli. It exposes renderers that consume resolved stories and return HTML artifacts with provenance.

Click to open its public-surface diagram. This is a dependency reference, not a claim that the CLI barrel re-exports diagram-core's APIs.
